title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Tool Rental Spend: Rental Rate Points
content:
Tool rental spend credited to a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership raises the ProBuild discount rate of a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement.

**Rule.** ProBuild tool rental spend adds points: when the ProBuild spend credited to the membership from tool rentals and posted in the last 12 months totals at least 6000.00 dollars, 1 point is added; when it totals at least 2500.00 but less than 6000.00 dollars, half a point (0.5) is added; when it totals less than 2500.00 dollars, none is added.

The points are added to the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement point for point, whatever the ProBuild tier's own rental discount percentage, a tier percentage of zero included.

**Which spend counts.** The spend postings on the ProBuild membership that credit a qualifying purchase made through tool rental, each posted fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the discount is posted. Spend from other purchase channels does not count.

## Spend bands

| Tool rental spend posted in the last 12 months | Points added |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 or more | 1 |
| 2500.00 to 5999.99 | 0.5 |
| below 2500.00 | 0 |

## Hypothetical readings

| Tool rental spend postings in the window | Total | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 1800.00, 2400.00, 1800.00 | 6000.00 | 1 (exactly 6000.00 qualifies) |
| 1500.00, 999.99 | 2499.99 | 0 |
| 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 0.5 |
| 3000.00 posted 13 months before the posting day | not counted | 0 |
